translations.web: to speak evil of no one, not to be contentious, to be gentle, showing all humility toward all men.
translations.bsb: to malign no one, and to be peaceable and gentle, showing full consideration to everyone.
translations.kjv: To speak evil of no man, to be no brawlers, but gentle, shewing all meekness unto all men.
translations.asv: to speak evil of no man, not to be contentious, to be gentle, showing all meekness toward all men.
